recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not revert the current example binding or reintroduce the removed problem-list/unknown warning under FHIR-29409; any future clinicalStatus cardinality or Condition.category policy change should be handled by its own later Jira decision.
issue_request: FHIR-29409 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested removal of the Condition.clinicalStatus invariant dependency on condition-category problem-list-item after the R4 Condition.category extensible binding made IPS Condition profiles/examples non-conformant. The final resolution required clinicalStatus 1..1, adding unknown to condition-clinical, removing the old con-3 dependency, loosening Condition.category binding strength, and adding explanatory comment text.
initial_application: Core commit 91c6eeca7e20574ca2f9d941bc0a19fe76539a45 explicitly applied J#29409 by setting Condition.clinicalStatus to 1..1, adding the requested comment, replacing the old problem-list-item-gated con-3 with a problem-list/unknown warning, and changing Condition.category from extensible to preferred. The Jira comments state that adding unknown required the UTG process rather than a core-source change.
additional_context: Condition is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. Current source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml has clinicalStatus 1..1 and unknown guidance, and the current con-3 is an abatement rule rather than the removed category-dependent clinicalStatus presence rule. UP-280 implemented the unknown code in the terminology source of truth. Later FHIR-39011 rejected reverting Condition.category to extensible, and later Applied issue FHIR-48358 changed Condition.category to example and removed the post-29409 problem-list/unknown warning.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the authoritative source already removes the old category-dependent clinicalStatus requirement, keeps clinicalStatus required with the requested guidance, obtains unknown from THO, and reflects later Condition.category decisions.
